subject.title: fix(memory-core): unify QMD multi-collection search, add phase timings, fix archived-session identity loss

question: Should QMD-specific call-plan, phase-timing, and dropped-hit diagnostics become a permanent public `memory-host-sdk` runtime-debug contract?
rationale: The diff marks new types public and extends a plugin-facing debug object; whether external plugins may rely on that surface is an API-direction choice rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Recommended: retain the diagnostics within memory-core or an internal host seam so this bug fix does not establish a new public SDK contract.

options.title: Approve a public SDK contract
options.body: Accept the new diagnostics as supported API, with explicit ownership and compatibility expectations for future memory-host implementations.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics internal
recommendation.body: Recommended: retain the diagnostics within memory-core or an internal host seam so this bug fix does not establish a new public SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main memory-core or memory-host SDK owner should decide the permanence of the plugin-facing diagnostics contract.
